verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a native 'export all data' feature or names any open file format. The only route out is programmatic: the official REST API and MCP server give full CRUD/read access to 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, so a user could build their own extraction with extra tooling. Spreadsheet sync is limited to the Advanced tier. Missing for 10: a documented one-click full-data export, explicit open formats (CSV/JSON/etc.), confirmation that the API covers all data (attachments, audit history, payroll), and independent or hands-on evidence of a successful migration away.
